mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password_hash, display_name, avatar_url, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
SELECT id, email, password_hash, display_name, avatar_url, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, email, password_hash, display_name, avatar_url, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{avatarUrl}, #{isActive}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET display_name = #{displayName}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
